en: The postcard shows the ruins of a large stone structure on a hilltop, overlooking a town with a grid of streets and many low-rise buildings. The ruin appears to be part of a medieval fortress or castle, with a partially collapsed wall and tower. In the foreground, two people stand at the edge of the ruin, enjoying the panoramic view of the town and the expansive plains beyond. The image is colored in a way that suggests it may be from the mid-to-late 20th century.
